name: HEJS 5312
title: Readings in Talmudic Literature
description: Selected readings from the Babylonian or Palestinian Talmud. Focus will be either a particular theme or a specific tractate. May be repeated for credit with a change of topic to a maximum of nine credits. May be repeated for a total of 9 credits.
requirement_description: Open to graduate students in Literatures, Cultures, and Languages; undergraduates by instructor consent.
